steps.content:
December 14
The mystery surrounding the cabinet attack was solved, with the perpetrator revealed as an Outland spy. The Fraser city representative initiated contact with the interim cabinet for discussions.

December 15
The FAC's special operation in the DisSea was terminated on an emergency notice. Its major forces were deployed to WhiteSands, with the mission details remaining undisclosed.

December 24
After the third election debate, Max King's approval ratings, which had been steadily climbing since the shooting incident, suddenly skyrocketed. Legal actions and financial probes against him were put on hold, media reports started taking a positive turn, and public opinion completely reversed.

Noon, December 25
Max King had an official meeting with the West District representative, Matilda Cavendish.

Evening, December 25
Cory Stewart, head of the Stewart family and brother of the late Prime Minister, was found dead in his residence. The time of death was estimated to be over a week ago, with the manner of death resembling that of his brother's a month earlier. The possibility of a revenge killing was not yet ruled out.

December 26, Dis Day
The Election concluded at 10:00 PM, with vote tabulation commencing promptly. Max King eventually emerged victorious by a significant margin and was announced as the new Prime Minister. The other ministers would be finalized in the coming days.

At 3:00 AM, Bernadette Cavendish extended her congratulations to Max King.
Discussions for the new cabinet lineup were in progress.

Morning, January 1
Acting Prime Minister Benjamin Carter finalized the handover procedures. Max King officially became the host of the City Hall and was set to deliver a New Year's address as DisCity's 22nd Prime Minister of the City Council.

January 1, N.F. 115
City Hall, Building 17, 105th Street, District 3, Eastside
Prime Minister's New Year's Address

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Dear DisCitizens, Happy New Year.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: One year ago today, I made a bold declaration that I would stand on this stage as DisCity's 22nd Prime Minister, bring real changes, and guide our city towards a new era of hope.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: That marked the beginning of my journey. Since then, I've crossed paths with many people, faced numerous challenges, and glimpsed realities of our world I never knew existed. Through these experiences, I've come to understand more deeply this city where I was born and grew up.

steps.speaker: What's your dream life like?
steps.content: And now, as I stand here true to my declaration, I find myself filled with emotions I never imagined I would experience.
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: They're quite unhappy about your defeat, saying that all their investment in you has gone to waste.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Heh, even if I had won, their problems wouldn't have magically vanished. Mr. King did have a point there.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: The West District would never accept someone like me in power. No matter what approach I took, they would never lower their guard against the established families. The price of upholding control would only grow higher over time.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Instead of trying to quash the matter at a significant expense, it's wiser to opt for a proxy everyone can accept to navigate through the temporary throes... The investors will soon grasp why.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Pull the right strings, and anyone can become a reliable puppet, don't you agree?
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: An assassination plot... a mentally unstable killer... Why are you showing me this? Are you trying to sabotage our rally?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: No. I believe you can prevent the attack early enough for your important rally to proceed, but then what? Will you win the election after that?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Surely you understand, Mr. Vale, that Mr. King alone cannot turn the current tides. This shooting plan... will be your final chance.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Hehe, so you want me to use this to stage a show, turn my master into an almost-victim hero, and help him win public trust?

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Even if we were to fabricate a story and stir up public sentiment, you still control the media and investigation permissions. You could easily discredit it all.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: What you really want is collateral. You are asking me to create evidence of our own guilt and deliver it directly into your hands.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: What I want is a commitment, a gesture of trust, and what I offer is the chance to put him in power.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Even if I go along with this charade, and my master secures his election through it, that won't change the fact of you holding proof it was all staged. The moment he defies any of your decisions in the future, you'll instantly take him down.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: That's only the worst-case scenario. We can always prevent it from happening. As long as Max proves himself to be a cooperative partner, my supporters will gladly back him instead.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: With the upcoming shooting incident, all related lawsuits will be dropped, financial restrictions lifted, public pressure dissolved, and the media will portray him as a hero. He embodies the persona of a "new-era" leader far more fittingly than I do, living right up to everyone's expectations.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: ...As long as you accept this plan.
[Exit Memory]

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Anyway, things have settled now. Now that you've come to talk with me, I suppose I've passed the evaluation?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: You're right. Congratulations.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: You did inherit Stewart's legacy, found yourself a perfect puppet, and used him as a stepping stone to reach where you wanted to be.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: But don't forget what I told you before.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Keep your distance from those old friends of yours.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Heh... Aren't you my ONLY old friend left now?
[EDGE door opens]
That journalist has been taken care of. Bernadette must hold onto such a precious key personally, to use it only when necessary.
Now, Bernadette ascends the steps, walking towards a new height, approaching those who were once far beyond her reach.
It's time for her to claim the spoils of her victory.
[02's portrait appears]

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Welcome, Bernadette Cavendish. Your adept management has upheld the Eastside Council through tumultuous times and effectively quelled the unrest in the West District. Your orchestration has been both well-crafted and innovative. You've demonstrated your capabilities.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: From today onward, the vacant Seat 05 is yours. You will assume the responsibilities that Stewart left unfulfilled. Lead the Eastside Council, and ensure they don't stray too far from the correct path.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Well then, congratulations on achieving what you desired.

steps.speaker: EDGE-05
steps.content: The honor is mine.
(Scene change)
A hundred years have elapsed... This city has nurtured its true masters, who have permeated into every vein like tumors, commanding its every breath.
The rules of the game grow increasingly sophisticated, old, and bloated, more greedier with each passing day. To protect its own interests, it staunchly opposes any form of change.
Nonetheless, the only constant in this world is change itself. The West District has cast the first stone, sending ripples that spread from top to bottom, inside to outside, from past to future...
[Entering Memory]

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: ...I accept it. Of course, I do.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: We've waited so long for an opportunity like this... Thank you for your generosity. I will make the most of this chance. While I regret breaking my master's trust, I know he will make it through.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: It doesn't have to be today. Once he reaches the right position, he will take action and honor his commitment. I look forward to seeing that day come.
[Exit Memory]
A smile plays across Bernadette's face. Time is running short, but she still wants to climb higher, to see broader horizons. And then... to welcome the dawn of revolution.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Happy New Year, young people of DisCity.
[Special Fade Out]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I now understand this city holds a vastness, depth, and complexity beyond what I ever imagined. This position is never glory—it carries a weight both lighter and heavier than I had anticipated.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: The world is changing, but I'm not the one who ushers in any new era. Time only moves forward, towards each of us, never stopping.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I will bear the responsibilities that are mine to carry—for those who have supported me, believed in me, and brought me here, and for every citizen who calls this city home alongside me.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Whether tomorrow brings light or darkness, whether you face it with hope or fear, whether our beliefs align or diverge—this era will embrace us all equally, and I will stand by your side to face it.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: And then... do everything we can to change it.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Now, it's time to brace ourselves.
[Small CG 1] Death

steps.speaker: Delicate Female Voice
steps.content: A new puppet, a new member, a new year, new troubles and burdens... You almost ruined my plans again.

steps.speaker: Delicate Female Voice
steps.content: If this keeps up, even I will get mad.

steps.speaker: Delicate Female Voice
steps.content: How about you go tell █ █ that this is becoming too much trouble, and maybe we should consider ending our collaboration? Making deals with you annoys me. Go play your games by yourself.
[Small CG 2] Famine

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: But you'll help regardless, right? So thank you. Besides, isn't an ending like this... quite intriguing?

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: To see DisCity's high-and-mighty election thrown into chaos by an Outlander, and watch a pitiful commoner flip the entire game board... Now that's what I call a worthwhile investment.

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: Thanks to our genius programmer setting up the network before going on vacation, I get to watch this show across the calamities, and even see my dear runaway sister.

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: Now, the game is on. Let's see when DisCity will be ready for what's coming.
[Small CG 3] War
You came back empty-handed? What happened to that unexpected gift you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: It was stolen, by those... "uninvited" guests.
Haha! What a pity, I was quite excited about meeting him.
steps.female_content: Haha! What a pity, I was quite excited about meeting her.

steps.content: At least that one's got more spine than this old geezer.
[Small CG 4] Commander-in-Chief
Eight years apart, and the FAC has become a pushover, just as expected.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: ...What do you want, coming back now?

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: DisCity won't repeat the same mistake. There's no place for you here. Get lost—I don't have time for you.
Oh? Outland spies freely roam your streets, the Underground has infiltrated everywhere, and anyone can walk all over you—Who exactly did you spend your time on?
Too busy being the puppet masters' lapdog?
Step down, you old fool. From now on, this battlefield is mine.
Once again, you find Elvira in the Bureau's underground shooting range.
No one will ever come to take her away. All the targets in the range lie shattered, yet she's still clutching the gun that fired at Jelena.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Back then, Elvira held a gun to her head and insisted that I take her there.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think she knew exactly what she's doing. She always did.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're a good shooter.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...No, I tend to miss when it really matters.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Sorry I didn't kill her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You just wanted her to break free from that madness and leave...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'll protect you from now on. That's what those two wanted most.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...There's no need. I... no longer need anyone's protection...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: My father... he told me a lot. Please let me stay, and be of use to you.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I... also have things I must do.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: The past year, and everything that came in the past, will be consigned to history. A new era has dawned...

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: We will face it together.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Happy New Year, DisCity, and my dear citizens.
[Black Screen]
[Scene Change] In a car heading to the satellite town
Jelena slowly opens her eyes. Moonlight spills into the car, and the subtle jolts of the journey sway both her consciousness and her blurred memories.
She can't discern her surroundings, yet in the distance, DisCity fades away on the distant horizon beyond the car window.
And the rain has stopped.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...I'm still alive...

steps.speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
steps.content: Yeah, it was a close call. If I had arrived a few minutes later, you might not have made it back.

steps.speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
steps.content: Where would you like to go now? I'll take you there.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Where to go?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Heh... Hehe...
Anywhere will suffice. She has already succeeded.
She swayed the election as promised, and kept the child safe, just as she always wished.

A more fitting protector with a more rightful stance has taken her place by the girl's side. Despite shifting times and adversaries to face, that person made a promise—one that will definitely be upheld unwaveringly.
She can finally rest easy now, and there's no longer any reason for her to stay.
Then... why is she still alive?

steps.speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
steps.content: Well... Take your time. We've got a long way to go.

steps.speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
steps.content: As long as you're alive, you'll find the answer one day.
Jelena can no longer hear it. Her laughter grows hollow, eventually dissolving into a fractured tune.
A new era has dawned... Yet I cannot... stay by your side... Don't let it sweep you away... Don't let it crush you... My beloved children... you must...
...Grow up strong...
